senses.gloss:
VASE, s. पात्रं, भाजनं, कुम्भः, कलशः -शी; ‘golden vase,’ गड्डुकः
-ड्डूकः, गडुकः, भृङ्गारः, कनकालुका, कनकालुः f.

VAST, a. सुमहान् -हती -हत् (त्), अतिमहान् &c., अतिवृहन् -हती &c.,
अपरिमितः -ता -तं, पुलः -ला -लं. See HUGE, IMMENSE.

VASUDEVA, s. (Father of Krishna, and son of Śūra, called
Ānakadundubhi, because at his birth the gods sounded
with joy the drums of heaven, as foreseeing that Viṣṇu
would take a human form in one of his family) वसुदेवः,
आनकदुन्दुभिः m., दुन्दुः.
